claim_boundary: fresh-seed confirmation of one descriptive carrier endpoint metric; no channel necessity, route mechanism, routing, adaptation, or learning claim
fitting_boundary: Fit only the base-order cue6 decoder, fixed projections 17/29/43, and carrier endpoint orthogonal tracker on base-order train32. Apply unchanged to paired eval32 in both primary arms.
carrier_metric: per-seed arm value is the mean over paired eval32 histories of mean squared frozen-carrier-tracker residual across carrier coordinates at delay8; c_s=base-upstream
outcome: per-seed median over fixed projections of delay8 base-minus-upstream true R2
confirmation_gate: Pass only if c_s<0 in at least 5/6 finite seeds, outcome>0 in at least 5/6 finite seeds, and leave-one-seed-out Spearman(c_-s,outcome_-s)<0 in at least 5/6 omissions. No alternate metric is considered on failure.
controls: save states fitted carrier tracker predictions per-history residuals and hashes
